stem: What happens next in this passage after “Medical progress came from observation, testing, and correcting mistakes.”?
options: Students visiting the farm learned that new tools can change old work without making old knowledge useless.
Students compared old tools with modern ones and felt grateful, but also thoughtful.
Students compared old maps with current ones.
Students compared them with modern metal and plastic pipes.
